Traffic Advisory 
In connection with Ramleela celebrations at DDA Ground, NSP (Opposite Haldiram) & TV Tower, Pitampura from 27th Sept to 2nd Oct 2025, 5:00–11:00 PM.

📍 Affected roads: Lala Jagat Narayan Marg (NSP to Kohat Enclave Red Light) & Dilli Haat Road
📍 Parking not permitted on festival routes
📍 Use alternate routes:
 • Wazirpur → Mangolpuri/Vikas Puri/Janak Puri: Wazirpur → Britannia → Punjabi Bagh → Right Turn → Peeragarhi Chowk
 • Prembari → Rohini: Prembari → Tikona Park → Maya Muni Ram Marg → Vaishali Chowk → Kohat Enclave Red Light
📍 Avoid festival stretches & follow traffic police directions
📍 Prefer public transport for convenience
